item.title: Welcome to the Mishka Test Blog
item.dc:creator: shahryar
item.content:encoded:
Welcome. This blog exists so a migration tool has something real to read: a few authors, nested categories, every kind of post status and a handful of media files.

Next, read about every core block or the classic editor.
item.excerpt:encoded: A first post: what this WordPress site is for and what you will find on it.

item.title: Every core block in one post
item.dc:creator: nadia
item.content:encoded:
This post uses the core blocks an importer meets most. A paragraph has bold, italic, an internal link, inline code, highlighted text, strikethrough and a line
break.

A level two heading

  • First item
  • Second item, with a nested list
    • Nested one

  def world, do: "Hello <World> & friends"
end

    keeps   its spacing
and its line breaks.

item.title: A classic editor post with shortcodes
item.dc:creator: omid
item.content:encoded:
This post was written in the classic editor, so its body has no block comments. WordPress turns blank lines into paragraphs when it shows the post (wpautop). A second paragraph with bold text, an internal link and an image link to the hero file.

A heading after the more tag

  • Two

item.title: Linking between posts and media
item.dc:creator: nadia
item.content:encoded:
Absolute permalink: the welcome post. Plain ID link: post by ID. Page ID link: page by ID.

Relative links: the team page and the blocks post. With an anchor: to a heading.

Media: the PDF, the hero attachment page, and a sized copy of the hero.

Archives: News, News by ID, the Elixir tag, Nadia.

Broken and external: a deleted post, elixir-lang.org, an email link.

item.title: نصب وردپرس روی سرور
item.dc:creator: omid
item.content:encoded:
در این نوشته وردپرس را روی یک سرور لینوکس نصب می‌کنیم. نشانی این نوشته نویسه‌های فارسی دارد، پس در نشانی اینترنتی به شکل درصد-کدگذاری‌شده دیده می‌شود.

پیش‌نیازها

  • یک سرور با دسترسی ریشه
  • پایگاه داده MariaDB
  • وب‌سرور Apache یا Nginx

برای ادامه، نوشته خوش‌آمدگویی را ببینید.
